title: HTML5 Elements and APIs Overview
description: Explore new semantic elements introduced in HTML5 and an overview of APIs like canvas, progress, meter, details, and summary.

lessons.title: Introduction to HTML5
lessons.content: HTML5 is the latest version of HTML, introducing new semantic elements and powerful APIs to create modern, interactive web pages.

lessons.title: New Semantic Elements
lessons.content: HTML5 introduced elements like <section>, <article>, <nav>, <aside>, <header>, <footer>, and <main> to improve page structure and accessibility.

lessons.title: The <canvas> Element
lessons.content: The <canvas> element allows drawing graphics on the fly using JavaScript, useful for games, charts, and animations.

lessons.title: The <progress> Element
lessons.content: The <progress> element displays a progress bar representing completion of a task.

lessons.title: The <meter> Element
lessons.content: The <meter> element shows a scalar measurement within a known range, such as disk usage or temperature.

lessons.title: The <details> and <summary> Elements
lessons.content: These elements create interactive disclosure widgets that users can open or close to show/hide additional content.

lessons.title: Example: Using <canvas>
lessons.content:
<canvas id="myCanvas" width="200" height="100" style="border:1px solid #000000;"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('myCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 150, 75);
</script>

lessons.title: Benefits of HTML5 Elements and APIs
lessons.content: These new elements and APIs improve accessibility, SEO, user experience, and allow richer, more interactive web applications without external plugins.
